records.claim: The time it takes the body to metabolize (to process) medication is not the same for everyone. In healthy non-pregnant adults, it can take up to 6 weeks, on average, for most of the semaglutide to be gone from the body. The product labels for Ozempic®, Wegovy®, and Rybelsus® recommend women who are planning a pregnancy stop this medication 2 months before getting pregnant.
records.source_section: I am taking semaglutide, but I would like to stop taking it before getting pregnant. How long does the drug stay in my body?
